name: Reconstructed Data Storage with Greedy Optimization
definition: A method to select which wavelet tree nodes should have their data pre-reconstructed and stored to trade storage space for run-time efficiency, maximizing the reduction in reconstruction time subject to a storage constraint.
summary: Reconstructed Data Storage with Greedy Optimization selects wavelet tree nodes to pre-store, maximizing reconstruction speed within storage limits using a greedy heuristic.
